description:
Monitor and manage package updates on Debian and Debian-based Linux distributions.

Features:
• Available updates and critical-update notifications.
• New, obsolete, residual and autoremovable packages.
• Automatic and manual update checks.
• Separate update and cleanup actions.
• Optional purge of residual configuration files during cleanup (off by default).
• Cleanup remains available when only residual configuration files exist and purging is enabled.
• APT and APT-get with default terminal detection.
• Nala with XFCE Terminal integration, including native residual configuration cleanup.
• Review and confirm cleanup transactions interactively.
• Graphical administrator authentication.
• Press any key to exit after terminal operations.
• Independent custom update and cleanup commands.
• Configurable update intervals and package ignore list.

Maintained by vanastasis.
GNOME Shell 48, 49, 50 and 51.
name: Debian APT Updates Indicator
